page.overview:
Who is Bengara?

Bengara was a male Twi'lek who lived in the settlement Mos Shuuta on the planet of Tatooine during the Galactic Civil War. Bengara was the proprietor of Offworld Trader's, a luxury goods shop established within an old rocket ship.
